copy.executive: What government programs buy beyond SpaceAware: security built for accreditation, the warfighting functions in the terms both research and operations use, real-time collaboration, integration with legacy systems at the edge, and deployment into CDAO environments. Each line says whether it is live today or a target.
copy.operator: The same tools, named as your mission uses them, with your organization's data and UDL beside the open catalog, shared with the people you work with, and running where your systems are, including disconnected ones.
copy.integrator: A Space Data Network node runs as a sidecar beside legacy systems, converting their messages to signed SDS records; modules are WebAssembly that runs in the browser, on WasmEdge on small hosts and offline. Certifications are listed as targets until each is granted.

live: Every record digitally signed at the source (Ed25519) and checked on arrival
The engine delivered encrypted and its signature checked before it runs
Paid modules encrypted to each account
Sign-in by passkey, password, seed phrase or wallet; no email needed
UDL credentials and data kept on the customer's own node
